response.sql: SELECT language_id, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(length) AS avg_running_time FROM film WHERE length > 112 GROUP BY language_id ORDER BY avg_running_time IS NULL, avg_running_time DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A long film runs more than 112 minutes; a film running exactly 112 minutes is excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: A long film runs at least 112 minutes, including films exactly at the cutoff.
